text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: 5xx spike detected for model-serving in az-east-2. Threshold crossed: 5xx rate > 0.8% over 5m. Pager fired: P12345. Please acknowledge.
PagerDuty: Pager P12345 triggered (policy: infra-oncall). Escalation in progress.
ryan (oncall): ack — taking it. seeing lots of 5xx and connection resets to model shards in az-east-2. grabbing logs now.
sarah-ops: on it, pulling routing/health dashboard. any confirmed customer impact yet?
emma-support: 3 active support threads reporting 502/timeout on inference endpoints, PRD customers affected.
matt-eng: logs show repeated TCP resets to nodes 10.4.7.* and KV-cache eviction spikes around the same time. stack traces pointing to network syscall timeouts.
nana-sre: (typo fix) ana-sre: proposing temporary routing diversion to az-east-1 to mitigate customer impact — we have headroom there.
ryan (oncall): agree. matt + ana coordinate the divert. sarah, prep the short customer comms. i'll update PD to show we're working it.
matt-eng: prepping weight change now. plan: route model-prod -> az-east-1 100%, az-east-2 0% (20m rollback TTL). CLI to run:
```
redwood route update --route model-prod --weights az-east-1=100 --weights az-east-2=0 --reason "az-east-2 5xx spike"
```
dev-deploy-bot: Starting routing change job j-8821. rollout strategy: immediate weights, canary checks enabled. ETA ~20s.
matt-eng: rollout applied. canary probes responding 200. az-east-2 errors trending down but still noisy on a subset of shards.
ryan (oncall): good. activating fallback routing. will notify customers externally.
emma-support: Sent customer note: "We detected elevated errors in one availability zone and are routing traffic to an alternate zone to restore service. We'll follow up with an incident report." template used.
nana-sre: (again) ana-sre: also enabling node drain for nodes reporting COMMS_FAIL to avoid noisy neighbors. command:
```
redwood node disable --zone az-east-2 --filter "status:COMMS_FAIL" --drain
```
matt-eng: node drain kicked off. KV cache warmup on az-east-1 should finish in ~30s. monitoring p95 and error-rate.
sarah-ops: metrics: p95 latency +80ms during switch but 5xx rate dropping to baseline. good short term.
PagerDuty: Pager P12345 acknowledged by ryan (oncall).
ryan (oncall): handing primary to ana for depth triage. ana, you're lead — i'll stay on for comms and postmortem coordination.
nana-sre: ana-sre: taking it. collecting node-level traces, NIC stats, and kernel logs now. opening incident INC-2026-042 and tagging eng-runtime + eng-infra.
dev-deploy-bot: job j-8821 completed successfully.
ryan (oncall): marking PD as in-progress; will keep this thread as the single source of truth. please update with findings and any rollback decisions. :white_check_mark:
nana-sre: initial impact summary logged in INC-2026-042: ~0.7% of global requests affected, primarily from az-east-2, ~3 paying customers reported errors. mitigation: routing diversion + draining COMMS_FAIL nodes. next steps: NIC egress drop RCA and hardware/driver checks.
ryan (oncall): thanks. if we see recurrence after reinstate of az-east-2, we'll schedule a controlled maintenance window. for now keep the diversion until ana says it's safe.
